'''Mearalis II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet boasted a number of [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges and was the source of [[Varpeline crystal/Legends|varpeline crystal]], which could be used as [[Kyber crystal|lightsaber crystals]].<ref name="Savage Spirits" />
